subject: [RFC PATCH 2/7] cgroup: add set_active_cgroup() to charge CPU time to a cgroup

2026-09-24.patch_summary: This patch adds a new function called set_active_cgroup() that allows a kernel thread to charge its CPU time to a specific cgroup instead of its own cgroup, usually root. The function sets the task's active_cgroup field and returns the old value. It first charges the time used so far to the old cgroup before setting the new active cgroup. This is necessary for tasks like memcg reclaim from a workqueue that do work for a cgroup but are not part of it. Only kernel threads in the root cgroup can call this function, and it warns and does nothing if called by other processes. The patch also adds code to charge system time to the active cgroup when set under set_active_cgroup().
